fieldNotes._location: Audited the operational NFI/Rent-A-Center cross-dock DC at 1901 Danieldale Rd in ProLogis Park 20/35 (~32.6366,-96.7955), NOT the supplied 510 E Pleasant Run Rd coords (32.6037,-96.7508), which resolve to a small unrelated industrial/contractor yard. The researchHint (NFI/Rent-A-Center DFW DC news release, ~650k SF) matches only the Danieldale building.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Continuous chain-link perimeter fence around the parcel; sliding gate at the auto/office entrance (SV pano j0sagb07-UCR3pXu55zgPw) and a fence-line gate where the SW internal drive enters the trailer/dock yard. Access is controlled.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No small staffed booth (1-3 vehicle footprint) identifiable at the truck lane in satellite z19-z21 or Street View; medium confidence.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Inferred true because a gate exists but no guard shack is visible, implying kiosk/call-box/app check-in (typical modern ProLogis cross-dock). Medium confidence.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock building: dock banks on BOTH long faces (SW face and NE face), so ship and receive run from physically separate dock clusters.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide multi-lane internal park drives and a deep gate apron (Walmart tractor-trailer seen on the open drive in SV); ample paved width to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Counted regular dock-door rhythm with trailers backed in along both long faces (each ~430m); well over 50 doors total. Band 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Marked trailer-parking stalls in the SE drop yard and along the aprons holding trailers without tractors; estimate in the 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Deep paved drive aisles and aprons inside the fence between the gate and the dock faces give large interior staging/queue room.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Gate-to-dock approach is long; the internal drive can hold 3+ trucks before reaching the dock faces.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Lancaster is part of the Dallas-Fort Worth metro; dense residential subdivisions abut the park to the E/S. Urban.
fieldNotes.yardMetrics: Dock-door/trailer counts are honest estimates from overhead imagery (Maxar/Vexcel via Google Static API). siteAreaAcres (24.5) derived from the perimeter polygon shoelace area; building alone ~650k SF per public reporting.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the parcel; the BNSF/DART line ~1km east does not enter the property.
